# MCP tool reference

The full Threatlint server exposes **73 tools** over stdio and Streamable HTTP.
This reference is generated from the same `tools/list` response clients receive. Custom
embedders may expose fewer tools when they omit backing services; discover the connected
server before calling a tool.

Start with [MCP and headless workflows](mcp.md) for installation, authentication, runnable
examples, resources, prompts, and job lifecycles. Paths and interactive browsers refer to
the server host. Use IDs returned by discovery/start calls in subsequent requests.

## Calling tools and reading results

Supply the listed arguments to MCP `tools/call`. For example:

```json
{"name":"open_workspace","arguments":{"repoPath":"/absolute/path/to/repository","confirm":true}}
```

Every successful call returns JSON text in `content` and the same decoded value in
`structuredContent.result`. The common output schema declares an unconstrained
`result` property whose shape depends on the tool; the schema does not promise a fixed
structure for that value. Check `isError` before reading it. Tool failures contain an
error message in text content; also handle protocol and transport errors in your client.

A successful start call acknowledges a job. Poll its status, inspect coverage and errors,
and retrieve the final report before treating the workflow as complete. Follow each
workflow guide for response IDs, pagination cursors, cancellation, and retention.

Required fields are marked **Yes**. Defaults in the table are schema defaults; additional
workflow defaults are described in the guides. Expand **Full input schema** for nested
objects, array items, enumerations, and all validation constraints. Open-ended `options`,
`filter`, and `config` objects also undergo shared service validation; see the linked
workflow examples for their accepted configuration.

MCP annotations are discovery hints: `readOnlyHint` describes mutation behavior,
`destructiveHint` flags potentially destructive changes, `idempotentHint` describes
repeatability, and `openWorldHint` flags interaction beyond the local service. They do
not grant permission. Required `confirm: true`, `confirmWriteback: true`, and `optIn: true`
fields record explicit intent; underlying authorization and evidence gates still apply.

### `list_models`

List models available to a provider using existing environment/CLI credentials or an optional session-only key. Codex and Bedrock allow explicit model entry; LM Studio uses a validated model-server URL.

**MCP annotations:** `readOnlyHint=true`, `destructiveHint=false`, `idempotentHint=true`, `openWorldHint=true`.

| Argument | Type | Required | Defaults and constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `provider` | string | **Yes** | Allowed: `"claude"`, `"claude-code"`, `"bedrock"`, `"daybreak"`, `"daybreak-bedrock"`, `"openai"`, `"copilot"`, `"codex"`, `"lmstudio"` |
| `key` | string | No | Max length: 4096 |
| `bedrockRegion` | string | No | Max length: 40 |
| `baseUrl` | string | No | Min length: 1; Max length: 2048 |

<details>
<summary>Full input schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "provider": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "claude",

        "bedrock",
        "daybreak",
        "daybreak-bedrock",
        "openai",
        "copilot",
        "codex",
        "lmstudio"
      ]
    },
    "key": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 4096
    },

      "type": "string",

    },

      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 2048
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "provider"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#"
}
```

## detect-xshell fleet scans

[Workflow guide and examples](mcp.md#sources-and-repository-checkout).

### `start_xshell_scan`

Scan many repositories for *-2Shell exposures (React2Shell / Next.js and RSC follow-ups, PHP2Shell, WP2Shell, Node2Shell) and *-4Shell exposures (Log4Shell, Spring4Shell, Text4Shell, Java4Shell) using connected GitHub and Azure DevOps sources. Choose all repositories or named ones, and the default branch, all branches, or named branches/wildcards per source. Reads lockfiles, Maven/Gradle build files and runtime pins (Dockerfile FROM tags, .nvmrc, .tool-versions, WordPress core) through provider APIs without cloning. Release lines with no fix are still reported (fixAvailable=false). Poll get_xshell_scan.

**MCP annotations:** `readOnlyHint=false`, `destructiveHint=false`, `idempotentHint=false`, `openWorldHint=true`.

| Argument | Type | Required | Defaults and constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `connections` | array of object | **Yes** | Min items: 1; Max items: 16; Connection IDs from list_sources.; Nested constraints: see full schema |
| `workers` | integer | No | Minimum: 1; Maximum: 8 |
| `maxRepositories` | integer | No | Minimum: 1; Maximum: 10000 |
| `maxBranchesPerRepository` | integer | No | Minimum: 1; Maximum: 500 |
| `confirm` | boolean | **Yes** | Must be `true` |

<details>
<summary>Full input schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "connections": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "connectionId": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 200
          },
          "repositories": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "type": "string",
                "const": "all"
              },
              {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "minLength": 3,
                  "maxLength": 300
                },
                "minItems": 1,
                "maxItems": 1000
              }
            ],
            "default": "all",
            "description": "\"all\", or owner/name (GitHub) and project/repository or organization/project/repository (Azure DevOps)."
          },
          "branches": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "default",
                  "all"
                ]
              },
              {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "minLength": 1,
                  "maxLength": 200
                },
                "minItems": 1,
                "maxItems": 20
              }
            ],
            "default": "default"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "connectionId"
        ],
        "additionalProperties": false
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 16,
      "description": "Connection IDs from list_sources."
    },
    "workers": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 8
    },
    "maxRepositories": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 10000
    },
    "maxBranchesPerRepository": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 500
    },
    "confirm": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "const": true
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "connections",
    "confirm"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#"
}
```

</details>

## Specialist jobs

[Workflow guide and examples](mcp.md#background-reviews-and-conversations).

### `start_review`

Start a background specialist review using a configured server-side provider. Returns a job ID; poll get_review. All source changes remain advisory.

**MCP annotations:** `readOnlyHint=false`, `destructiveHint=false`, `idempotentHint=false`, `openWorldHint=true`.

| Argument | Type | Required | Defaults and constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sessionId` | string | **Yes** | Min length: 1; Max length: 200 |
| `agentIds` | array of string | **Yes** | Min items: 1; Max items: 23; Nested constraints: see full schema |
| `target` | string | No | Max length: 12000 |
| `provider` | string | No | Allowed: `"claude"`, `"claude-code"`, `"bedrock"`, `"daybreak"`, `"daybreak-bedrock"`, `"openai"`, `"copilot"`, `"codex"`, `"lmstudio"` |
| `model` | string | No | Max length: 200 |
| `options` | object | No | Additional existing Workbench request fields, such as provider credentials, ensemble consent, or integration options. Validated by the shared service; never overrides explicit IDs. Prefer environment credentials.; Nested constraints: see full schema |
| `execution` | object | No | Nested constraints: see full schema |
| `attachment` | object | No | Nested constraints: see full schema |
| `designInputsId` | any JSON value | No | — |
| `continueOnError` | boolean | No | — |
| `confirm` | boolean | **Yes** | Must be `true` |

```json
  "properties": {

      "type": "string",

      "maxLength": 200
    },
    "agentIds": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "enum": [
          "appsec-threat-modeler",
          "appsec-code-reviewer",
          "appsec-dependency-auditor",

          "appsec-iac-reviewer",

          "appsec-compliance-checker",
          "appsec-attack-tree",
          "appsec-red-team",
          "appsec-threat-delta",
          "appsec-verify-fix",
          "appsec-runtime-reviewer",
          "appsec-business-logic-reviewer",
          "appsec-client-security-reviewer",
          "appsec-crypto-reviewer",
          "appsec-ai-security-reviewer",
          "appsec-security-test-planner",
          "appsec-secure-codegen-reviewer",
          "appsec-privacy-reviewer",
          "appsec-xshell-detector"
        ]
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 23
    },
    "target": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 12000
    },
    "provider": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "claude",
        "claude-code",
        "bedrock",
        "daybreak",
        "daybreak-bedrock",
        "openai",
        "copilot",
        "codex",
        "lmstudio"
      ]
    },
    "model": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 200

      "type": "object",

      "description": "Additional existing Workbench request fields, such as provider credentials, ensemble consent, or integration options. Validated by the shared service; never overrides explicit IDs. Prefer environment credentials."
    },
```

## Findings

[Workflow guide and examples](mcp.md#findings-and-decisions).

### `list_findings`

Read revision-bound findings, composites and review status in a workspace.

**MCP annotations:** `readOnlyHint=true`, `destructiveHint=false`, `idempotentHint=true`, `openWorldHint=false`.

| Argument | Type | Required | Defaults and constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sessionId` | string | **Yes** | Min length: 1; Max length: 200 |
| `branch` | string | No | Max length: 500 |
| `commit` | string | No | Max length: 200 |
| `contentDigest` | string | No | Max length: 200 |
| `section` | string | No | Allowed: `"findings"`, `"revisionFindings"`, `"observations"`, `"composites"`, `"trends"` |
| `offset` | integer | No | Minimum: 0 |
| `limit` | integer | No | Minimum: 1; Maximum: 100 |

<details>
<summary>Full input schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "sessionId": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200
    },
    "branch": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 500
    },
    "commit": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 200
    },
    "contentDigest": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 200
    },
    "section": {
      "type": "string",

        "revisionFindings",

        "trends"

      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0

  "additionalProperties": false,

}
```

### `ingest_findings`

Import revision-bound scanner or external observations into a workspace. Imported verification is always reported; a separate evidence-backed review is required.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `confirm` | boolean | **Yes** | Must be `true` |

| `branch` | string | No | Max length: 500 |
| `commit` | string | No | Max length: 200 |
| `contentDigest` | string | No | Max length: 200 |
| `observedAt` | number or string | No | Nested constraints: see full schema |
| `coverage` | object | No | Nested constraints: see full schema |
| `findings` | array of object | **Yes** | Max items: 10000; Nested constraints: see full schema |

### `review_finding`

Record an explicitly attested, evidence-backed disposition. Verification must describe work actually performed. False-positive and remediation evidence gates remain enforced.

**MCP annotations:** `readOnlyHint=false`, `destructiveHint=false`, `idempotentHint=false`, `openWorldHint=false`.

| Argument | Type | Required | Defaults and constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sessionId` | string | **Yes** | Min length: 1; Max length: 200 |
| `findingId` | any JSON value | **Yes** | — |
| `confirm` | boolean | **Yes** | Must be `true` |
| `review` | object | **Yes** | Nested constraints: see full schema |

```json
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 8000

          "type": "array",

            "anyOf": [
              {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "path": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "maxLength": 2000
                  },
                  "reference": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "maxLength": 3000
                  },
                  "line": {
                    "anyOf": [
                      {
                        "type": "integer",
                        "minimum": 1,
                        "maximum": 100000000
                      },
                      {
                        "type": "null"
                      }
                    ]
                  },
                  "quote": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "maxLength": 12000
                  },
                  "kind": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "maxLength": 60
                  },
                  "verification": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "reported",
                      "verified"
                    ]
                  },
                  "verificationMethod": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "maxLength": 2000
                  },
                  "refutes": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "maxLength": 100
                  }
                },
                "additionalProperties": false
              },
              {
                "type": "string",
                "maxLength": 3000
              }
            ]
          },
          "maxItems": 100
        },
        "basis": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "claim": {
                "type": "string",
                "minLength": 1,
                "maxLength": 4000
              },
              "evidenceIds": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "anyOf": [
                    {
                      "$ref": "#/properties/sessionId"
                    },
                    {
                      "type": "integer",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 99
                    }
                  ]
                },
                "minItems": 1,
                "maxItems": 100
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "claim",
              "evidenceIds"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          },
          "minItems": 1,
          "maxItems": 30
        },
        "safeBehavior": {
          "type": "string",
          "maxLength": 8000
        },
        "at": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "type": "number",
              "minimum": 0,
              "maximum": 8640000000000000
            },
            {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1,
              "maxLength": 100
            }
          ]
        }
      },
      "required": [

        "reason",
        "newEvidence",
        "basis"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "sessionId",
    "findingId",
```
```json
    "confirm",
    "review"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#"
}
```

</details>

### `correlate_findings`

Save an evidence-backed attack chain without changing standalone dispositions or adding component severities. Contributors must belong to this workspace and the same known revision.

**MCP annotations:** `readOnlyHint=false`, `destructiveHint=false`, `idempotentHint=false`, `openWorldHint=false`.

| Argument | Type | Required | Defaults and constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sessionId` | string | **Yes** | Min length: 1; Max length: 200 |
| `confirm` | boolean | **Yes** | Must be `true` |
| `title` | string | **Yes** | Min length: 1; Max length: 1000 |
| `contributors` | array of object | **Yes** | Min items: 2; Max items: 30; Nested constraints: see full schema |
| `links` | array of object | **Yes** | Min items: 1; Max items: 100; Nested constraints: see full schema |
| `impact` | object | **Yes** | Nested constraints: see full schema |
| `complexity` | object | **Yes** | Nested constraints: see full schema |
| `riskRationale` | string | **Yes** | Min length: 1; Max length: 8000 |
| `uncertainty` | array of string | **Yes** | Max items: 30; Nested constraints: see full schema |
| `coverage` | string | **Yes** | Min length: 1; Max length: 8000 |
| `at` | number or string | No | Nested constraints: see full schema |

```json
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "sessionId": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200
    },
    "confirm": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "const": true
    },

      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 1000
    },

        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "findingId": {

          },

          "role",
          "rationale"

      "minItems": 2,
      "maxItems": 30
    },
    "links": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "prerequisite": {
            "$ref": "#/properties/sessionId"
          },
          "effect": {
            "$ref": "#/properties/sessionId"
          },
          "rationale": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
```

### `preview_developer_risk`

Build an explicitly opted-in private coaching preview using verified introduction evidence. Does not persist scores, rank people, or infer responsibility from authorship.

**MCP annotations:** `readOnlyHint=true`, `destructiveHint=false`, `idempotentHint=true`, `openWorldHint=false`.

| Argument | Type | Required | Defaults and constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sessionId` | string | **Yes** | Min length: 1; Max length: 200 |
| `optIn` | boolean | **Yes** | Must be `true` |
| `subject` | string | **Yes** | Min length: 1; Max length: 200 |
| `observedChangeCount` | integer | **Yes** | Minimum: 1; Maximum: 100000 |
| `observations` | array of object | **Yes** | Max items: 1000; Nested constraints: see full schema |

<details>
<summary>Full input schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "sessionId": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200
    },
    "optIn": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "const": true
    },
    "subject": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200
    },
    "observedChangeCount": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 100000
    },
    "observations": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "findingId": {
            "$ref": "#/properties/sessionId"
          },
          "introduced": {
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "introductionEvidenceIds": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "$ref": "#/properties/sessionId"
            },
            "maxItems": 100
          },
          "exposure": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "internet",
              "internal",
              "local",
              "unknown"
            ]
          },
          "exposureEvidenceIds": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "$ref": "#/properties/sessionId"
            },
            "maxItems": 100
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "findingId",
          "introduced",
          "introductionEvidenceIds",
          "exposure"
        ],
        "additionalProperties": false
      },
      "maxItems": 1000
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "sessionId",
    "optIn",
    "subject",
    "observedChangeCount",
    "observations"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#"
}
```

### `save_report`

Save a complete report written by the MCP client model. Marked as a client review; does not claim server-side execution or validation.

**MCP annotations:** `readOnlyHint=false`, `destructiveHint=false`, `idempotentHint=false`, `openWorldHint=false`.

| Argument | Type | Required | Defaults and constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

```json
        "appsec-business-logic-reviewer",
        "appsec-client-security-reviewer",
        "appsec-crypto-reviewer",
        "appsec-ai-security-reviewer",
        "appsec-security-test-planner",
        "appsec-secure-codegen-reviewer",
        "appsec-privacy-reviewer",
        "appsec-xshell-detector"
      ]
    },
```

### `export_report`

Export a saved report as base64 byte chunks. Decode and concatenate chunks locally; no HTTP/UI or server path is needed.

**MCP annotations:** `readOnlyHint=true`, `destructiveHint=false`, `idempotentHint=true`, `openWorldHint=false`.

| Argument | Type | Required | Defaults and constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sessionId` | string | **Yes** | Min length: 1; Max length: 200 |
| `reportId` | any JSON value | **Yes** | — |
| `format` | string | No | Allowed: `"md"`, `"json"`, `"docx"`, `"pdf"`; Default: `"md"` |
| `findingId` | string | No | Max length: 40; Pattern: `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*-\d+$` |
| `offset` | integer | No | Minimum: 0 |
| `limit` | integer | No | Minimum: 1; Maximum: 262144 |

<details>
<summary>Full input schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "sessionId": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200
    },
    "reportId": {
      "$ref": "#/properties/sessionId"
    },
    "format": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "md",
        "json",
        "docx",
        "pdf"
      ],
      "default": "md"
    },
    "findingId": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*-\\d+$",
      "maxLength": 40
    },
    "offset": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 262144
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "sessionId",
    "reportId"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#"
}
```

</details>

## Keeping this reference current

From a source checkout with the Workbench dependencies installed:

```bash
npm --prefix web run docs:mcp
npm --prefix web run docs:mcp:check
```

The first command regenerates this page; the second fails when it differs from the
registered tools. CI runs the check with the Workbench suite. Generation uses an
in-memory protocol connection and inert services; it does not invoke tools, open a user
profile, or contact providers. Update workflow guides alongside semantic changes.
